fusions.name: Sporefall
fusions.desc: Looses a cone of spores 6 tiles long that deals 3 damage to everything caught in it. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Diseased] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Earthstar Pop
fusions.desc: Hurls a puffball that bursts on impact, dealing 30 damage and leaving the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds. Every other enemy within 3.5 tiles takes 80% of that damage.

fusions.name: Spawn Carpet
fusions.desc: Spreads a mat of mycelium up to 4 tiles away. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and every ally inside it.

fusions.name: Universal Host
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. You regenerate 1 health a second.
